messages:
anya (PM): Quick: we need a short GA gate checklist for SLA/monitoring/support/docs/pricing. Can we assign owners?

derek (Eng): I can own SLA wording and breach payload examples. Recommend two-hosted tiers: Std / Priority.

fiona (SRE): I'll own monitoring and runbooks. Monitoring items: synthetic p95/p99, hot-pool util, cache hit-rate. Alerts: 5m regression -> sev2, 15m sustained -> sev1.

oliver (Docs): Ill draft public SLA + internal runbook links. Need example JSON for breach and a short customer-facing pricing blurb.

mira (Pricing): I'll create pricing delta table. Proposal: Priority = +30% unit price for pilot. Will add sample invoices for 10k/100k tokens/day.

ben (Support): Support will own oncall routing and L1 playbook. Pilot customers get 24/7 paging, GA Std gets business-hours triage.

ci-bot: smoke-tests scheduled: ga-priority-smoke @ 2026-06-10T05:00Z. Failures -> #deploys.

anya (PM): Owners recap: derek (SLA), fiona (monitoring/runbook), oliver (docs), mira (pricing), ben (support). Targets: drafts by EOD tomorrow.

derek (Eng): sample breach payload for docs: ```{
  "customer_id": "cust_42",
  "window": "2026-06-01/2026-06-30",
  "p95_ms": 220,
  "slo_p95_ms": 120,
  "credit_pct": "0.05%"
}```

fiona (SRE): I'll push monitoring dashboards and a runbook link when ready.

oliver (Docs): Will ping for copy review.

mira (Pricing): Will post spreadsheet.

ben (Support): I'll create the pilot channel and train L1 on Wednesday.

anya (PM): Good. Gate for GA: pilot stability (no sev1 >48h), billing/credits tested, docs and runbooks published, monitoring live. Meeting Thu to review. :thumbsup:
